# Krita Manual

> Complete documentation for Krita 5.3, a professional open-source digital painting application with comprehensive guides for users, artists, and contributors.

Krita Manual 5.3.0 provides extensive resources for digital artists, from installation and basic concepts to advanced techniques in painting, animation, and layer management. The documentation supports multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, and Linux, and covers integration with drawing tablets like Wacom.

## Key Topics

- Krita 5.3
- Digital painting
- Brushes and tools
- Layers and blending modes
- Drawing tablets (Wacom)
- Animation
- File formats (SVG, EPUB)
- Color theory
- Installation
- Getting started
- Filters and effects
- Open-source software
- Python scripting
- HDR Display
- User manual

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to the Krita 5.3 Manual](https://docs.krita.org/en): Main entry point to Krita 5.3 documentation with overview of manual contents
- [Getting Started](https://docs.krita.org/en/user_manual/getting_started.html): Beginner guide covering installation, navigation, and basic digital painting concepts
- [Krita FAQ](https://docs.krita.org/en/KritaFAQ.html): Frequently asked questions covering system requirements and troubleshooting

## User Manual

- [User Manual](https://docs.krita.org/en/user_manual.html): Comprehensive user manual covering installation, drawing tablets, brushes, and file management
- [General Concepts](https://docs.krita.org/en/general_concepts.html): Educational reference on art fundamentals, color theory, and file formats
- [Tutorials and How-tos](https://docs.krita.org/en/tutorials.html): Step-by-step guides on painting techniques, brush tips, and layer workflows

## Reference Manual

- [Reference Manual](https://docs.krita.org/en/reference_manual.html): Technical reference for Krita tools, blending modes, brushes, layers, animation, and filters
- [Index](https://docs.krita.org/en/genindex.html): Searchable index of documentation with file formats and command-line options

## Community and Resources

- [Resources](https://docs.krita.org/en/resources_page.html): Curated collection of brush packs, textures, templates, and community content
- [Contributors Manual](https://docs.krita.org/en/contributors_manual.html): Guide for community contributors on workflow, markup standards, and translation
